open_loop.actions: k0 closed-loop sequence; mirror for k10; air uses identical saved ground sequence
open_loop.air: fixed root at world z2.5, identity initial orientation and zero root velocities, no contact; diagnostic cfg only

perturbation.definition: impose root world z angular velocity equal to signed epsilon before each of first10 control steps; no repeated additive accumulation

error_definitions: full per-component signed differences retained; group L2 and Linf reported; first absolute component threshold crossing per quantity/env; quaternion sign canonicalized; origins subtracted; contact reflection swaps bodies and flips Y force
O: initial observation/action Linf>1e-5 OR air post-first-step joint_pos/joint_vel/applied_torque Linf>1e-5
N: O absent; observation/action evaluated on exactly mirrored fixed initial inputs and air within1e-5; ground starts<=1e-5 and grows exponentially; epsilon<=0.05 flips slope signs
H: O absent; air passes; first contact-step error>=1e-4 and epsilon0.2 does not flip signs
other: report all evidence without forcing classification
exponential_growth: fit log(error) vs time from first contact until0.01 or2s, at least10 positive points; positive slope and R2>=0.8; report per trial and aggregate, no posthoc threshold change
flip: relative to matching unperturbed k0 env slope, sign crosses zero; report per-env positive/negative/zero/fallen, any_flip and majority_flip separately; decisive flip requires majority flips for at least one signed epsilon in every training seed; partial/mixed results => other
fall_handling: retain all resets and terminated masks; slopes reported only continuous initial trial through20s; separately report censored exposure
recommendations: only one next-step recommendation; do not implement it
